title: Computer Science Bachelor’s Core
description: A four-stage self-study spine for the computing core of a rigorous bachelor’s degree: mathematics, programming, theory, systems, and a substantial project.

courses.title: MIT 6.1200 Mathematics for Computer Science
courses.description: Proofs, discrete structures, graphs, counting, probability, and recurrences.

courses.title: MIT 18.06 Linear Algebra
courses.description: A full linear-algebra foundation for computing and later specialization.

courses.title: Substantial individual or team capstone
courses.description: Design, build, test, document, and defend a system that integrates the preceding material. Use a faculty, practitioner, or peer-review process rather than treating deployment alone as assessment.
